name: Roblox Flappy Bird
desc:
A widescreen version of one of the most popular games, Flappy Bird, playable in Roblox!
Featuring new things like duels, skins and multiplayer so you can play with your friends!
Too hard? There is an easy mode setting waiting for you and many others!

Too many visible players? You can hide them in the settings!

Sprites taken from the Flappy Bird Wiki.
Developed by EmK530.
